Joana Santos

Front-end Developer
Future Designer

I'm Joana, a front-end developer based in Brazil with a passion for design, open knowledge, and technology as tools for change.

I believe in the power of the internet as a democratic and creative space. My work lives at the intersection of code, design, and community.

When I'm not building things on the web, you'll find me thinking about accessibility, visual communication, and how art intersects with activism.
